definitions.explanation: An outbreak of spots, redness, or irritation on the skin, typically caused by allergies, infections, or other medical conditions.

examples.english: A rash appeared on my arm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{発疹|はっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A rash can appear due to a drug allergy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{発疹|はっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Red rashes spread all over my body, so I went to the hospital immediately.

notes:
A medical term composed of ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (outbreak, occurrence) and {疹|しん} (rash). The standard word for skin rashes in both medical and everyday contexts.

PRONUNCIATION:
The reading はっしん is standard. An older reading ほっしん also exists but is less common today. Be careful not to confuse with the homophone ⟦{発信|はっしん}→発信：04895_hasshin⟧ (sending, transmitting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発疹|はっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ — a rash appears
- {発疹|はっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧ — a rash spreads
- {発疹|はっしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ — a rash subsides
- ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧{発疹|はっしん} — allergic rash

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{湿疹|しっしん}→湿疹：06951_shisshin⟧ — eczema, dermatitis (chronic or recurring skin condition)
- ⟦{蕁麻疹|じんましん}→蕁麻疹：15182_jinmashin⟧ — hives, urticaria (raised itchy welts)
- ⟦かぶれ→かぶれ：25271_kabure⟧ — rash from contact irritation (more casual)
